description: The Suggest (K) card's tooltips for the two Hidden terms whose glossary help was rewritten to ask about the enemy's NEXT turn (13.09: ranged attacks 'during this turn or during the previous turn'; light OR dense terrain per the errata): 'Stays Hidden' (hidden_gain, F001: 'Bonus for ending where the unit will be Hidden in the enemy's next turn (in light or dense terrain, and its last shots no longer count by then).') and 'About to regain Hidden' (tv_regains_hidden, F003: 'It will be Hidden in its next turn (in light or dense terrain, its last shots no longer counting by then) - shoot it while it can still be targeted.'). Board: ai_move_cover's (exam mv05's position: Custodian Guard B 2.2" north of obj_nml_1's dense ruin area-large-2, P2's Custodian Guard A far south, everyone else parked), with tests/bench_profiles/yt_findings_on.json loaded (the Hidden weights ship OFF). (a) MOVEMENT: the engine says the approach end in the ruin is Hidden next turn; a real click on Suggest (K), the squad focused, shows a movement record pricing 'Stays Hidden'; every option's details opened through the panel's own toggle; the card's bbcode carries 'Stays Hidden' as a [hint] whose tooltip is the rewritten help; screenshot; control: the profile cleared, no such part. (b) SHOOTING: P2's Prosecutors moved into area-large-2 ~9" south of the squad with the shot record of their own last turn (index cur - 1): the engine says not Hidden now, Hidden at cur + 1, and an eligible target; K shows the squad SHOOT with the Prosecutors' Target priority made of the x1.25 'About to regain Hidden' part, its tooltip the rewritten help; screenshot; controls: a shot record from THIS turn (still counting next turn) and the shipped defaults give no such part.

steps.script: main._ai_suggestion_panel != null and main._ai_suggestion_panel.visible

steps.comment: the card's movement record prices ending Hidden (4.0 x the share of enemy guns it hides from)

steps.script:
# Hover 'Stays Hidden' in the live card: find the point whose tooltip is the
# glossary help (RichTextLabel.get_tooltip answers the [hint] under a point),
# then warp the cursor there and send a motion event, as the runner's hover
# acts do, so the tooltip opens for the screenshot.
var p = tree.current_scene._ai_suggestion_panel
var rich = p._rich
var want = AIReasoningGlossary.help("hidden_gain").replace("\"", "'").replace("]", ")").replace("[", "(")
var hit = Vector2(-1, -1)
var y = 4.0
while y < rich.size.y and hit.x < 0.0:
	var x = 4.0
	while x < rich.size.x:
		if str(rich.get_tooltip(Vector2(x, y))) == want:
			hit = Vector2(x + 8.0, y)
			break
		x += 6.0
	y += 6.0
if hit.x < 0.0:
	return "no point of the card shows that tooltip"
var gp = (rich.get_global_rect().position + hit).round()
Input.warp_mouse(gp)
var mm = InputEventMouseMotion.new()
mm.position = gp
mm.global_position = gp
mm.relative = Vector2(1, 0)
Input.parse_input_event(mm)
return str(rich.get_tooltip(hit)) == want

steps.comment: the rewritten help open as the hover tooltip of 'Stays Hidden'

the Prosecutors' target priority carries the x1.25 'regains Hidden' part
